findings.documented: API metadata reports total = 4110 and the documentation says the listing endpoint should stop at that metadata total.
findings.actual: Pagination continued beyond the metadata total and returned 4400 retrievable listing records; offset 4399 returned a valid listing and offset 4400 returned no results.
findings.how_found: The local fetchAll helper was inspected and rerun with offset increments of results.length until the returned result page became empty; specifically the run confirmed that offset 4399 returned one valid record and offset 4400 returned an empty page.
findings.impact: The extraction must not use data.total as a stopping condition; it must continue until the API returns an empty page or has_more is false, yielding 4400 actual listing records rather than the documented 4110 metadata total.
